exposure: Home-based growth monitoring and promotion (GMP) services
Facility-based growth monitoring and promotion (GMP) services
Caregiver knowledge of GMP or GMP cards
Caregiver involvement with an NGO, association, or health program
outcome: Utilization of growth monitoring and promotion (GMP) services
Children receiving weight and length measurements
cohort: The study included 3038 randomly selected mothers and children under one year old from six sub-districts in rural Mymensingh district of Bangladesh.
finding: Home-based GMP services showed significantly higher utilization rates (40%) compared to facility-based services (0%), with caregiver awareness, access to GMP cards, and NGO involvement positively influencing utilization in home-based areas.
